description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for a web application, including features such as Markdown preview, Bootstrap tooltips, alert messages, form change detection, external link decoration, and JSON data extraction.

methods.name: syncScrolling
methods.description: Synchronizes scrolling between a textarea/input and a linked preview element.

methods.name: initTootips
methods.description: Initializes Bootstrap tooltips on elements with data-bs-toggle='tooltip'.

methods.name: alertMessage
methods.description: Creates and appends a Bootstrap-styled alert message to a target element.

methods.name: decorateExternalLinks
methods.description: Adds an external link icon to links pointing outside the current origin.

methods.name: decodeHtml
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in a string.

methods.name: getJsonData
methods.description: Retrieves and parses JSON data embedded in an element's innerText.
